subject: I wasn't supposed to share this yet
preview_text: But you're one of the first to see what's coming next in SoulPlan. Trust me, you want this.
body_paragraphs: Remember that moment when you realized your date night needed a serious upgrade? That feeling when the same old dinner-and-a-movie just wasn't cutting it anymore. Well, something big is coming to SoulPlan, and I'm about to let you in on a secret before anyone else.

We've been quietly building something that's going to change how you plan surprises for your partner. Imagine this: you open the app, and instead of scrolling through endless ideas, you get a custom-crafted date experience that feels like it was designed just for the two of you. No more guesswork, no more last-minute panic.

Here's the sneak peek: we're adding a feature that learns your partner's hidden preferences even better than you do. It'll suggest dates they'll love but would never think to ask for. And the best part? It'll be ready in just a few weeks. You're getting this because you're an early user, and we want you to be the first to know.

For now, start using the surprise date planner in the app. It's the closest thing to what's coming, and it'll help you both get into the groove of letting the app handle the heavy lifting. Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together today and try planning a surprise date for this weekend. P.S. If you don't tell anyone I told you about this, I'll let you know when the new feature goes live before anyone else does.
